description: The Swiss National Bank's current policy rate: the rate, the date it took effect, the previous rate and when that one took effect, plus recent decision history. Computed from cube snboffzisa (series LZ, monthly) rather than left for the caller to infer a decision date from get_cube's raw observations. The SNB sets a single target value (no corridor) since the 2022 policy-rate redesign.
name: snb_policy_rate
